semantic.justification: Task76 ports Original exact-index/default/currency-decimal/currency-integer/zero selection and actual empty Sequence assignment with native default-initialized NumberFormatCode and locale decimal separator. Default adjustment mutates original compound storage after caller COW,retains medium/long ordering and duplicate-medium flags CALC-272. Decimal projects only the consumed current-language field;optional LocaleData diagnostics are not represented. Full formatter constructor/table and document paste remain pending. Task76 adds the actual SvNFFormatData table owner,exact native key/type lookup,locale-block lookup and case-sensitive ordered same-language search. ImpInsertFormat consumes real scanner/ActLnge projections and generated NumberFormatCode values;it preserves native empty-code failure,duplicate-code/position disposal,default marking and owned comment assignment. Currency/prefix/other pattern services remain explicit unported admission boundaries. The General-only phase of ImpGenerateFormats uses the real XNumberFormatCode interface and source mapper,actual Sequence COW/default policy,scanner and compiled entries,then forces NUMBER/standard and overwrites the shared nThousand field with builtin limit100. It does not replace or claim the remaining builtin generator or a complete SvNumberFormatter service. Native object fields retain MaxCLOffset0,missing-currency sentinel,bNoZerofalse and empty format/default-key maps. Numeric sorting preserves consumed std::map traversal;physical STL tree destructor order is not represented and admitted entries have no destructor callbacks. CALC-273 documents the provably unreachable position-offset>=10000 guard after offset=position-position%10000 for all uint32 positions;observable source insertion results are preserved. Full language/formatter construction,remaining builtins,document paste/history and task74 remain pending.
